text.description_html:
Deltana FPG12, Heavy Duty Solid Brass 12" Offset Surface Bolt

This Deltana 12 Inch Offset Surface Door Bolt can be installed horizontally or vertically on the surface of almost any door. The guides on this heavy duty door bolt are held in place with a unique ball bearing system that eliminates scratches on the barrel of the bolt, hold tension on the bolt and prevents the guides from rattling. Package includes 12 inch surface bolt, mortise strike plate, universal strike plate, angle strike plate, 3 bolt guides and matching oval phillips head finish brass wood screws. The FPG12 12 Inch Offset Surface Door Bolt is made of solid brass and available in either oil rubbed bronze or polished chrome.

Also Available: 6" Offset Surface Bolt, 10" Offset Surface Bolt, 18" Offset Surface Bolt, 26" Offset Surface Bolt, and 42" Offset Surface Bolt

Specifications for the Deltana FPG12 12 Inch Offset Surface Bolt:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Bolt Length: 12"
  • Bolt Width: 5/8" Diameter Half Round Rod
  • Bolt Offset: 5/8"
  • Knob Diameter: 1-13/16"
  • Bolt Throw: 1-1/16"
  • Rod Resistance: 109 lbs.
  • Includes 3 Strike Plates
  • Packaged with all mounting hardware
  • Wood Screws: oval phillips head #6 x 1-1/4"
  • Deltana FPG12 12 Inch Surface Bolt Dimensions (PDF)

No matter which finish you choose for the outside, it will still be solid brass material inside.
